text: The Cartographers mapped a new mountain pass. Cuts two days off the northern route.
The old imperial road east of the Reach is clear again. Safe passage guaranteed.
A surveyor found a bloom-free valley beyond the Broken Engine. Perfect for a settlement.
The Compact's master map of the undervaults vanished from a locked archive.
The Cartographers now charge a toll for their route markers. Coin or favors.
The river path flooded and swallowed a whole caravan. Their maps were wrong.
An apprentice swears the Cartographers chart more than roads — they chart the Bloom's spread.
One map bears a door marked in a district where no building stands.
